chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: No one set the band's style; Haymen's violin; the Plaza photograph
summary: The style came from the whole group; Wendell Haymen played violin, and a photograph from the Plaza in 1927 is described.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: The whole thing with this band is no one person was setting the style of the band?
I think that is exactly what happened.
There was no violin player in the band?
That's right, he was the violin player. I forgot about that.
(Inaudible) was playing guitar in this band too at that time?
I think he was still playing banjo.
There's a guitar sitting there; it doesn't necessarily mean he played it, but there is a guitar.
